Hakkerovim kesherim lehattir nedarim ushevuot. umattirin ballayla umeummad. sheen hahetter hazze din. lefichach nishalin lishvuot velindarim beshabbat im hayu letzorech hashshabbat. kegon sheyyattiru lo shevuato kede sheyyochal veyishte hayyom. vaafillu haya lo penay lehattir shevuato o nidro meerev shabbat hare ze mattir beshabbat hoil vehu letzorech hashshabbat: 
Reuven shehishbia leshimon veana amen. o kibbel hashshevua venicham shimon al shevuato venishal aleha. en mattirin lo ella bifne reuven shehishbio. vechen im nishba reuven o nadar shello yehane mishshimon o shello yehane bo shimon venicham venishal lechacham en mattirin lo ella bifne shimon shennadar mimmennu hanaya. vaafillu haya shimon katan o akkum en mattirin lo ella befanav kede sheyyeda hanniddar shehittir ze nidro o shevuato ulefichach yehane mimmennu o yahane lo: 
Echad hannishba beno leven atzmo veechad hannishba barabbim. vaafillu nishba bashshem hameyuchad baAdonai elohe yisrael venicham hare ze nishal al shevuato umattirin lo. nishba al daat rabbim o shennadar al daat rabbim en mattirin lo leolam ella lidvar mitzva: 
Ketzad. nishba vetala shevuato bedaat rabbim shello yehane bifloni leolam vehutzrechu bene otah hair lilmod tora o lemi sheyyamul et benehem o sheyyizbach lahem velo nimtza ella ze bilvad hare ze nishal lechacham o lishlosha hedyotot umattirin lo shevuato veose lahem mitzvot ellu venotel secharo meotan haanashim shennishba shello yehane mehem: 
Mi shennishba velo nicham al shevuato uva levet din lekayyem shevuato. im rau haddayyanin shehetter shevua zo gorem lemitzva uleshalom ben ish leishto ben adam lachavero veshekkiyyum shevua zo gorem laavera veliktata potchin lo petach venosin venotnin immo baddavar umodiin lo devarim sheggoremet shevuato ad sheyyitnachem. im nicham bedivrehem mattirin lo veim lo nicham veamad bemiryo hare ze yekayyem shevuato: 
Ketzad. nishba sheyyegaresh et ishto o shello yehane yisrael minnechasav o shello yochal basar veshello yishte yayin sheloshim yom vechayyotze baze omrim lo beni im tegaresh et ishtecha atta motzi laaz al banecha veomrim haam mippene ma nitgarsha imman shel ellu ulemachar korim lahem bene gerusha veshemma tinnase leacher vei atta yachol lehachezirah vechayyotze bidvarim ellu. vechen ze shennishbata shello yehane yisrael minnechasecha lemachar yitztarech ze vetihye over al <small>(Vayikra 25 36)</small> "veche achicha immach" <small>(Vayikra 25 la)</small> "vehechezakta bo" o <small>(Devarim 15 8)</small> <small>(Devarim 15 11)</small> "patoach tiftach" vechayyotze bahen. veze shennishbata shello tochal basar veshello tishte yayin sheloshim yom hare atta pogea baregel umevattel simchat yom tov veoneg shabbat. im amar illu hayiti yodea ze lo hayiti nishba mattirin lo veim amar af al pi chen lo nichamti verotze ani bechol ze en mattirin lo: 
En potchin benolad. ketzad. nishba shello yehane bifloni venaasa sofer hair. hoil velo nicham al shevuato en potchin lo bedavar ze. vaafillu amar hu meatzmo illu hayiti yodea lo hayiti nishba en mattirin lo hoil vaadayin lo nicham ella retzono shello yehane lo veshello yease ze sofer. aval im nicham hu meatzmo mippene hannolad venehefcha dato mattirin lo. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Mi shennishba al davar venishba shello yattir shevua zo venicham. hare ze nishal al hashshevua haacharona techilla shennishba shello yattir veachar kach yishal al harishona: 
Nishba shello yedabber im peloni venishba achar kach sheim yishal al shevua zo veyattirah yihye asur lishtot yayin leolam venicham. hare ze nishal al hashshevua harishona umattirah. veachar kach yishal al hashsheniyya. sheen mattirin neder o shevua sheadayin lo chalu. lefichach im haya omed benisan venishba shello yochal basar sheloshim yom merosh chodesh iyyar venicham eno nishal ad sheyyikkanes iyyar: 
Nishba shello yehane lifloni veshello yehane lechacham sheyyishal lo al shevua zo. nishal al harishona veachar kach yishal al hashsheniyya: 
Nishba shello yehane lifloni vahare hu nazir im yishal al shevua zo. yishal al shevuato techilla veachar kach al neziruto. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Shevua shello ochal hayyom shevua shello ochal hayyom shevua shello ochal hayyom. o sheamar al kikkar zo shevua shello ochalenna shevua shello ochalenna shevua shello ochalenna. venishal al shevua rishona vehuttera hare ze chayyav mishshum shevua sheniyya. vechen im nishal al hashsheniyya chayyav mishshum shelishit. nishal al hashshelishit bilvad chayyav mishshum rishona usheniyya. nishal al hashsheniyya chayyav mishshum rishona [ushelishit]. im ken mippene ma amru en shevua chala al shevua. sheim lo nishal vaachalah eno chayyav ella achat kemo shebbearnu: 
Mi shennishba shevuat bittuy lehabba veshikker bishvuato. kegon shennishba shello yochal pat zo vaachalah veachar sheachalah kodem sheyyavi karbano im haya shogeg o kodem sheyyilke im haya mezid nicham venishal lechacham vehittirah lo. hare ze patur min hakkarban o min hammalkot. velo od ella afillu kefatuhu lilkot venishal vehittiru lo kodem sheyyatchilu lehalekoto hare ze patur:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 7:
Hattovea chavero bemamon sheim hoda bo yihye chayyav leshallem vechafar venishba. o shehishbio hattovea vechafar. hare ze hannitba hu chayyav bishvuat happikkadon af al pi shello ana amen. shebbishvuat happikkadon echad hannishba mippi atzmo veechad shehishbio acher vechafar af al pi shello ana amen chayyav. shekkefirato achar shehishbio hattovea kaaniyyat amen: 
Tevao bemamon sheim yode lo veyomar ken haddavar lo yihye chayyav leshallem. kegon shettevao biknas sheen adam meshallem kenas al pi atzmo. vechafar venishba. hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy: 
Vechen im tevao bekarka o beeved o bishtar vechafar venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker: 
Velamma niftar mishshum shevuat happikkadon vahare ze illu hoda chayyav haya umeshallem ma shekkafar. lefi shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 21)</small> "befikkadon o vitsumet yad o begezel o ashak et amito" <small>(Vayikra 5 22)</small> "o matza aveda" hakkol mittaltelin sheim yode bahen yotzi mamon mittachat yado. veyatzu karkaot sheen mittaltelin vahare hen lifne baalehen uvechezkatan. veyatzu avadim shehukkeshu lekarkaot. veyatzu shetarot sheen gufan mamon: 
Echad hannishba achar shettevao baal hammamon. o hannishba meatzmo af al pi shello tevao. ketzad. kegon shekkadam veamar lamma atta holech acharay kelum yesh lecha beyadi mamon shevua sheen lecha beyadi mamon. hare ze chayyav bishvuat happikkadon hoil vechafar venishba veaf al pi shello tevao ze: 
Echad hannishba levaal hammamon atzmo o lishlucho habba behareshaato. sheshshelucho shel adam kemoto: 
Veeno chayyav bishvuat happikkadon ad sheyyashbio belashon shehu makkirah: 
Hannishba shevuat happikkadon bemezid af al pi shennishba lashsheker vehitru bo edim bishat shevuato eno loke ella mevi ashamo bilvad. shehare hakkatuv motzio mikkelal chayyave malkot vechiyyevo asham ben bezadon ben bishgaga kemo shebbearnu: 
Kafar venishba arba o chamesh peamim. o shehishbio hattovea arba vechamesh peamim vehu kofer al kol achat veachat ben bevet din ben shello bevet din hare ze chayyav karban asham al kol shevua ushevua. sheillu hoda achar shekkafar haya chayyav leshallem af al pi shekkafar bevet din venimtza poter atzmo bechol kefira uchefira min hattashlumin. lefichach chayyav al kol shevua ushevua: 
Hayu chamishsha tovin oto veomrin lo ten lanu pikkadon sheyyesh lanu beyadcha. shevua sheen lachem beyadi eno chayyav ella karban echad. shevua sheen lecha beyadi lo lecha velo lecha velo lecha chayyav al kol achat veachat: 
Amar lo chavero ten li pikkadon utesumet yad gezel vaaveda sheyyesh li beyadcha. shevua sheen lecha beyadi eno chayyav ella achat. vaafillu haya lo peruta achat mikkullan hare ellu mitztarfin vechayyav: 
Shevua sheen lecha beyadi pikkadon tesumet yad gezel vaaveda chayyav al kol achat veachat: 
Ten li chittim useorim vechussemin sheyyesh li beyadcha. shevua sheen lecha beyadi eno chayyav ella achat. shevua sheen lecha beyadi chittim useorin vechussemin chayyav al kol achat veachat: 
Hayu chamishsha tovin oto veomrin lo ten lanu pikkadon gezel vaaveda utesumet yad sheyyesh lanu beyadcha. veamar laechad mehen shevua sheen lecha beyadi pikkadon vegezel vaaveda utesumet yad velo lecha velo lecha velo lecha hare ze chayyav al kol taana vetaana lechol echad veechad venimtza ze chayyav esrim asham: 
Taan sheavad happikkadon o kafar bo venishba veachar kach hoda. vechazar vetaan sheavad venishba vechazar vehoda. meshallem hakkeren harishon vechomesh echad al kol shevua ushevua shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 24)</small> "vachamishitav". hattora ribbeta chomashin harebe al keren echad. ketzad. haya hakkeren arbaa vechafar venishba vehoda vechazar vetaan sheavad venishba vechazar vehoda vechazar vetaan sheavad venishba vehoda meshallem shiva. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Pachot mipperuta eno mamon lefichach hattovea chavero befachot mipperuta o befachot mishsheve peruta vechafar venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 8: Haggonnev shoro shel chavero utevacho o mecharo. tevao baal hashshor veamar lo ganavta shori vetavachta o macharta vehu omer ganavti aval lo tavachti velo macharti venishba hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda meatzmo shettavach o machar lo haya meshallem tashlume arbaa vachamishsha mippene shehu kenas kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot geneva. venimtza ze kemo shello kafar mamon ulefichach patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker shello tavach vehu tavach:

Vechen haomer lachavero hemit shorcha et avdi vechafar venishba vehaeved shettava rabbo veamar hippalta shinni vesimmeta eni vechafar venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda lo haya meshallem mippene shehu kenas. aval chayyav bishvuat bittuy. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hattovea et chavero bedavar sheyyesh bo kenas sheeno meshallem oto al pi atzmo kemo shebbearnu. veyesh bo mamon shehu meshallem oto al pi atzmo. vechafar bechol davar venishba hare ze chayyav mishshum shevuat happikkadon. ketzad. tevao veamar lo anasta o pittita bitti vehu amar lo anasti velo pitteti venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon. sheaf al pi sheeno meshallem kenas al pi atzmo illu hoda haya meshallem boshet ufegam al pi atzmo. vechen haomer lachavero ganavta shori vehu omer lo ganavti venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon sheaf al pi sheeno meshallem kefel behodaato meshallem hu et hakkeren behodaato:
Haomer lachavero asita bi chabbura vehu omer lo asiti. hemit shorcha et shori vehu omer lo hemit venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon sheillu hoda haya chayyav leshallem:

Natan shoro leshomer chinnam umet hashshor. tevao veamar lo hechan shori shehifkadti etzlecha amar lo lo hifkadta etzli kelum o sheamar lo hifkadta venignav o avad venishba hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda veamar haddavar keshehaya lo haya chayyav leshallem mamon mippene shehu shomer chinnam. aval chayyav hu mishshum shevuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hishil shoro lachavero utevao veamar lo hechan shori sheshshaalta mimmenni vahare hashshor met. veamar lo hashshoel nignav o avad venishba al ze hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. shehare lo patar atzmo min hattashlumin bichfirato. umikkol makom chayyav hu leshallem ben met o nignav o avad o nishba mippene shehu shoel kemo sheyyitbaer bimkomo. aval chayyav hu mishshum shevuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Ze hakkelal kol sheeno poter atzmo min hattashlumin ella bichfira zo venishba ben mippi atzmo ben shehishbio hattovea vechafar hare ze chayyav bishvuat happikkadon af al pi shello ana amen velo hotzi shevua mippiv:

Haggonev shor chavero utevao veamar lo shori ganavta vehu omer lo ganavti. ma tivo etzlecha atta hifkadto etzli venishba. chayyav bishvuat happikkadon. sheillu hoda sheggenavo haya chayyav leshallem deme hashshor mikkol makom veachshav sheamar pikkadon hu hare patar atzmo bichfira zo min haggeneva umin haaveda sheim nignav hashshor o avad achar hodaa zo haya patur milleshallem:

Vechen im taan shessecharo venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare patar atzmo min hashshevura umin hammita. vechen im taan veamar hishalto li venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare patar atzmo min hammita bishat hammelacha kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot hashsheela:

Lefichach im amar lo ganavti aval atta hifkadto etzli o sechartani leshamro o hishaltihu li vahare shorcha lefanecha kachehu venishba al ze hare ze patur mishshevuat happikkadon. shehare hoda bakkeren velo patar atzmo bichfira zo mikkelum:

Vechen im amar lo atta mecharto li vaadayin lo natatti damav im tirtze kach damav o hare shellecha lefanecha. o sheamar lo atta netatto li bischar melacha sheeese lecha im tirtze sheeese lecha o kachennu valech. toe badderech metzativ velo yadati shehu shellecha achshav sheyyadati kachennu valech. o sheamar achar parati ratz vahare hu lefanecha. venishba al kol taana meellu patur mishshevuat happikkadon shehare lo patar atzmo mikkelum. vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker:

Mi shehaya chayyav mamon lishne shuttafin utevao echad mehen vechafar bo venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare kafar mamon. tevauhu shenehem vehoda bakkol leechad mehem veamar lo laviti ella mizze levaddo venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon shehare lo patar atzmo mikkelum. aval chayyav bishvuat bittuy:

Vechen mi shehayta alav milve bishtar vechafar bah venishba patur mishshevuat happikkadon. shehare bishtar nishtabed hakkarka venimtza ze kechofer bekarka. uchevar bearnu shehakkofer bekarka patur mishshevuat happikkadon vechayyav bishvuat bittuy shehare nishba al sheker:

Hayta alav milve beedim bilvad vechafar venishba chayyav bishvuat happikkadon shehare patar atzmo bichfirato milleshallem atta. veaf al pi shekkesheyyavou haedim yitchayyev leshallem venimtza shello hoila lo kefirato. hare hoila beittah veshemma lo yavou haedim o yavou velo titkayyem edutan o yippaslu ulefichach chayyav:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 9:
Hattovea edav lehaid lo edut sheyyitchayyev hannitba beedutan levaddah litten letovea ze mamon hammittaltel. vechafru beedutan venishbeu. ben shennishbeu bevet din ben shennishbeu chutz levet din hare ellu chayyavin mishshum shevuat haedut. shehare hifsiduhu mamon bichfiratam. vechen im hishbiam hattovea vechafru bo af al pi shello nishbeu hen velo anu amen achar shevuato kevan shekkafru hare ellu chayyavin. vehu sheyyashbiem bevet din: 
En haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ad sheyyichperu beedutan bevet din. ben shennishbeu o hishbian bevet din ben shennishbeu o hishbian chutz levet din. vehakkefira bevet din bilvad. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "im lo yaggid venasa avono" makom sheyyaggid veyoil hu sheim lo yaggid sham yitchayyev: 
Tevaan beedut sheenah mechayyevet mamon o beedut karkaot o avadim o shetarot vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut. sheen chayyavin ella al kefirat edut mamon sheddoma lefikkadon utesumet yad vegezel vaaveda sheppertan hakkatuv bapparasha shehen mittaltelin sheggufan mamon uchesheyyaidu laze yitten ze: 
Vechen hammashbia ede kenas vechafru peturin mishshevuat haedut. mippene sheim kadam hannitba vehoda biknas yippater milleshallem veaf al pi shebbau haedim achar ken veheidu. nimtzeu haedim lo chiyyevu ze beedutan levaddah ella edutan im kefirat hannitba hi hamechayyevet otan vehoil veim hoda lo toil edutan im kafru bah venishbeu peturin: 
Mashbiachem ani shettavou vetaidu li sheyyesh li beyad peloni tashlume kefel vetashlume arbaa vachamishsha vechafru. chayyavin bishvuat haedut mippene hakkeren shehu mamon lo mippene hakkefel shehu kenas. vechen im hishbiam sheyyaidu lo sheanas peloni o pitta bitto vechafru chayyavin bishvuat haedut mippene habboshet vehappegam sheim hoda bahem hannitba meshallem lo mippene hakkenas. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
En haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ad sheyyichperu veyishshavu achar teviat baal din atzmo o shelucho. aval im kadmu venishbeu kodem sheyyitbaem peturin mishshevuat haedut: 
Ketzad. rau hattovea holech acharehen amru lo lamma atta ba acharenu shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut mippene shello tevaan hattovea ella hem kadmu venishbeu bitviat atzman. vechen im hishbiam hannitba sheim tedu laze shettovea oto edut shettavou vetaidu lo vechafru hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut ad sheyyashbiem hattovea. veen tzarich lomar im hishbiam sheyyavou veyaidu sheyyesh lifloni beyad peloni mamon vechafru shehen peturin sheen ze hattovea baal din atzmo. vechen im kadma shevua laedut hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 1)</small> "veshama kol ala vehu ed". shekkadma edut lishvua lo shekkadma shevua leedut: 
Ketzad. mashbia ani alechem keshettedu li edut shettavou uteiduni veamru amen veyadu lo edut achar ken utevaam lehaid vechafru bo hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut: 
En haedim chayyavim bishvuat haedut ad sheyyeyached otam hattovea veyashbiem o yishshavu. ketzad. amad bevet hakkeneset veamar mashbia ani kol mi sheyyeda li edut sheyyavo veyaid li veanu kullam amen veedav bichlalam veachar kach tava edav vechafru bo hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut. mippene shello yiched edav bishvua bifne atzman. aval im amar mashbia ani kol haomdim kan sheim yedu li edut sheyyavou veyaidu li vehayu edav bichlalam vechafru hare ellu chayyavin bishvuat haedut shehare yichadam bichlal acherim: 
Vechen im amar laedim bou vehaidu li sheyyesh li mane beyad peloni. veachar kach amad bevet hakkeneset vehishbia kol mi sheyyodea lo edut yavo veyaid velo bau velo heidu hare ellu chayyavin. shehare tevaan techilla. vehu sheyyihyu az bevet hakkeneset veyihye sham bet din. aval im lo hayu bifne bet din im anu amen chayyavin bishvuat haedut kesheyyichperu beedutan bevet din veim lo anu amen enan chayyavin: 
Echad hammashbia edav bishvua. o sheamar lahen metzavve ani alechem bishvua oserchem ani bishvua hare ellu chayyavin. vehu sheyyashbiem beshem o bechinnuy min hakkinnuyim kemo shebbearnu: 
Veen haedim chayyavin ad sheyyashbiem belashon shehem makkirin otah: 
Hinne lamadta sheen haedim chayyavin bishvuat haedut ella al pi asara devarim. veellu hen. sheyyitbaem hattovea. veshettihye edut mamon. vesheyyihye mamon hammittaltel. vesheyyitchayyev hannitba leshallem beedutan levad im heidu. vesheyyichperu achar shettevaan hattovea. vesheyyichperu bevet din. veshettihye sham shevua beshem o bechinnuy. veshettikdam yediat haedut lashshevua. vesheyyeyached edav beet hashshevua o beet hattevia. veshettihye hashshevua belashon shehen makkirin otah: 
Kol makom sheamarnu patur. patur mishshevuat haedut aval chayyav bishvuat bittuy vehu shennishba o sheana amen im hishbio acher shehare nishba al sheker. aval hamechuyyav bishvuat haedut af al pi shehu nishba al sheker veaf al pi shehu mezid eno chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy ella mishshum shevuat haedut bilvad. shehare hakkatuv hotzi shevuat haedut mikkelal shevuat bittuy lechayyev hammezid bah keshogeg bekarban aval lo bemalkot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 5 4 5)</small> "leachat meelle". bemin echad mimmine shevuot atta mechayyev hannishba vei atta mechayyevo bishne minin ad sheyyihye chayyav bedin shevuat haedut uvedin shevuat bittuy: 
Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou vetaidu li sheyyesh li beyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad gezel vaaveda. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut enan chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut sheyyesh lecha beyad peloni pikkadon utesumet yad gezel vaaveda chayyavin al kol achat veachat: 
Mashbia ani alechem im lo tavou vetaidu li sheyyesh li beyad peloni chittim useorim vechussemin. shevua sheen anu yodin lecha edut enam chayyavin ella achat. shevua sheen anu yodim lecha edut sheyyesh lecha beyad peloni chittim useorim vechussemin chayyavin al kol achat veachat: 
Vechen im tavu otan rabbim lehaid lahem veamru shevua sheen anu yodin lachem edut enan chayyavin ella achat. lo lecha velo lecha velo lecha chayyavin al kol achat veachat kederech shebbearnu bishvuot happikkadon: 
Hannishba lachavero shehu yodea lo edut venimtza sheeno yodea lo edut hare ze patur veen kan lo shevuat haedut velo shevuat bittuy. mippene sheshshevuat bittuy enah ella bedavar sheyyesh bo lav vehen. veim yomar shevua sheeni yodea lecha edut en ze shevuat bittuy ella shevuat haedut. hoil velav ze sheyyesh bah enah shevuat bittuy. kach hen shebbah shehu hannishba sheyyodea lo edut eno shevuat bittuy: 
Davar barur hu shehannishba lachavero sheheid lo vehu lo heid o shello heid lo vehu heid hare ze chayyav mishshum shevuat bittuy veen kan shevuat edut kelal:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 10:
Hayu edav o echad mehen pasul o karov vaafillu mippesule edut shel divrehem. o shehaya hammelech echad meedav sheeno rauy lehaid. o shehayu ed mippi ed vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut sheillu (hodu) heidu lo hayu mechayyevin beedutan mamon: 
Mashbia ani alechem shettavou vetaidu li sheamar ish peloni sheyyitten li matayim zuz velo natan vechafru hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut. sheim heidu bedavar ze lo yitchayyev hannitba mamon baamirato. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Tevaan lehaid lo shehu kohen o levi o sheeno ben gerusha o ben chalutza vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut sheen kan edut mamon: 
Tevaan sheyyaidu lo shechaval bo beno veshehidlik peloni gedisho beshabbat vesheanas peloni o pitta bitto hameorasa vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut. sheim heidu edut zo yitchayyev hannitba mitat bet din veeno chayyav tashlumin kemo shebbearnu behilchot naara. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haya ed echad vechafar vehishbio patur mishshevuat haedut sheen edut ed echad mechayyevet mamon: 
Tava et shene edav sheyyaidu lo shezzinneta ishto vechafru venishbeu hare ellu chayyavin bishvuat haedut. sheillu heidu hayu mafsidin lah ketubbatah veyippater ze shettevaan vahare kafru beedut mamon: 
Tava ede kinnuy o ede setira vechafru venishbeu peturin mishshevuat haedut sheillu heidu en chiyyuv mamon kan ella lehashekotah bilvad. veaf al pi sheedut zo goremet lah shettafsid ketubbatah im lo tishte davar sheggorem lemamon eno kemamon shehare efshar shettishte velo tishbor ketubbatah: 
Hare shekkinne leishto venistera beedim vezanta beed echad achar hakkinnuy vehassetira vehishbia ed ze sheyyavo veyaid vechafar chayyav bishvuat haedut sheaf al pi shehu ed echad illu heid edut zo hayta yotza belo ketubba kemo shebbearnu behilchot sota: 
Vechen kol ed echad shemmechayyev mamon beeduto im kafar venishba o shehishbio bevet din vechafar chayyav mishshum shevuat haedut: 
Ketzad. kegon shehaya hattovea vehannitba chashudin al hashshevua sheen mashbiin otam vehishbia leed echad sheyyavo veyaid lo sheyyesh lo beyad ze mane vechafar hare ze chayyav mishshum shevuat haedut sheillu heid haya hannitba hazze meshallem mamon beeduto kemo sheyyitbaer behilchot toen. vechen kol kayyotze baze: 
Haishsha shehishbia ed echad sheyyaid lah bemitat balah vechafar chayyav bishvuat haedut sheillu heid hayta nisset venotelet ketubbatah: 
Bamme devarim amurim keshehaya lah ligbot ketubbatah min hammittaltelin. aval im en lah ligbot ketubbatah ella min hakkarka hare ze patur mishshevuat haedut. vechen im hayu shenayim. shehammashbia ede karka peturin kemo shebbearnu: 
Hishbia edav bevet din vechafru shenehem keachat kegon shehitchil hashsheni lichpor betoch kede dibburo shel chavero shenehem chayyavin bishvuat haedut vechol echad veechad mevi chattato al shevuato. kafar harishon veshaha haed hashsheni yoter mikkede dibbur veachar kach kafar. harishon chayyav bishvuat haedut vehashsheni patur mishshevuat haedut. sheillu hoda ze hashsheni lo hayta eduto mechayyevet mamon: 
Hoda echad vechafar echad hakkofer chayyav ben shekkafar battechilla ben shekkafar bassof. kafru shenehem keachad vekadam haechad vehoda betoch kede dibbur hare ze patur vehaomed bichfirato chayyav bishvuat haedut: 
Hishbia shete kitte edim ushetehen reuyot lehaid. vechafra kat rishona veachar kach kafra kat sheniyya. harishona petura mishshevuat haedut mippene shehen somchin al edut sheniyya veefshar lehotzi hammamon beedut hakkat haacheret venimtza ze hannitba eno chayyav leshallem beedut ellu shekkafru levaddah. hayta hakkat hashsheniyya kerovin lattovea o lannitba binshotehen vahare hen gossot af harishona chayyevet. shehare hashsheniyya beet kefirat harishona lo hayta reuya lehaid veaf al pi shebbimhera yihyu reuyin kesheyyamutu ellu haggossot. veim kafra hashsheniyya achare shemmetu neshotehen chayyavin bishvuat haedut: 
Hattovea et haedim lehaid lo vechafru vehishbian veanu amen vehishbian arba vechamesh peamim vehen onin achar kol shevua ushevua chutz levet din ucheshebbau levet din hodu veheidu hare ellu peturin mishshevuat haedut kemo shebbearnu. veim bau levet din veamdu bichfiratan chayyavin al kol achat veachat meotan hashshevuot shechutz levet din: 
Bamme devarim amurim besheanu amen. aval im lo anu amen ella kafru al kol shevua ushevua hoil velo hotziu shevua mippihem velo anu amen hare ellu peturim ad sheyyashbiem bevet din veyichperu bo sham kemo shebbearnu: 
Hishbian bevet din vechafru vechazar vehishbian arba vechamesh peamim vehen kofrin al kol achat veachat ben chutz levet din ben bifne bet din vaafillu anu amen o nishbeu mippi atzman paam achar paam enan chayyavin mishshum shevuat haedut ella achat mippene sheachar shekkafru bevet din im chazru vehodu en edutan moelet kelum: 
Nimtzeta lamed shekkol hashshevuot shennishbeu achar shekkafru bevet din hen al kefirat edut sheenah mechayyevet mamon shehen peturin aleha mishshevuat haedut vechayyavin bishvuat bittuy kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 11:
Keshem sheshshevuat shav vesheker belo taase. kach mitzvat ase sheyyishshava mi shennitchayyev shevua bevet din bashshem shenneemar <small>(Devarim 6 13)</small> <small>(Devarim 10 20)</small> "uvishmo tishshavea" zo mitzvat ase. shehashshevua bishmo haggadol vehakkadosh middarche haavoda hi vehiddur vekiddush gadol hu lehishshava bishmo: 
Veasur lehishshava bedavar acher im shemo. vechol hameshattef davar acher im shem hakkadosh baruch hu bishvua neekar min haolam. sheen sham mi sherauy lachlok lo chavod shennishbain bishmo ella haechad baruch hu: 
Umuttar leadam lehishshava al hammitzva laasotah kede lezarez et atzmo veaf al pi shehu mushba aleha mehar sinay shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 119 106)</small> "nishbati vaakayyema lishmor mishpete tzidkecha": 
Shevua zo shemmashbiin haddayyanim lemi shennitchayyev shevua hi hannikret shevuat haddayyanin. ben shehaya chayyav bishvua zo min hattora ben shehaya chayyav bah middivre sofrim: 
Shelosha mine shevuot hen shechayyavin bahen min hattora. veellu hen. mi shetteano chavero mittaltelin vehoda bemiktzatan vechafar bemiktzatan. umi shekkafar bechol hammittaltelin shetteano veed echad meid alav umachchisho hare ellu shete shevuot al yede taanat vadday uchefira. vechen shomer shettoen sheavad davar shehifkidu etzlo o nignav o met vechayyotze baze hare ze nishba missafek. sheen baal happikkadon yodea im emet toen ze hashshomer o sheker. vehu nishba min hattora shenneemar <small>(Shemot 22 10)</small> "shevuat Adonai tihye ben shenehem": 
Kol shevua shemmashbiin otah haddayyanin chutz mishshelosha mine shevuot ellu hare hi middivre sofrim vegam hi hannikret shevuat haddayyanin. vegam shevuot ellu middivrehem shene mine shevuot hen. yesh mehen shevuot al yede taanat vadday uchefira kegon shevuat sachir ufogem shetaro vechayyotze bahen. veyesh mehen shevuot betaanat safek kegon shevuat hashshuttafin vehaarisin vechayyotze bahen. uvedine mamonot yitbaer chiyyuv kol achat veachat meellu hashshevuot vedinehem: 
Veyesh sham shevua acheret vehi takkanat chachme haggemara vehi hannikret shevuat hesset. veaf al pi shebbet din mashbiin otah [hayyom] enah nikret shevuat haddayyanin: 
Ushevuat haddayyanin ben shehayta shel tora o shel divre sofrim ben al taanat vadday ben al taanat safek kach hi. hannishba ochez sefer tora bizroo vehu omed venishba beshem o bechinnuy bishvua o beala mippiv o mippi haddayyanin. vehoru rabbotay sheen mashbiin shevuat haddayyanin ella bilshon hakkodesh: 
Ketzad mippiv. kegon sheyyomar hareni nishba baAdonai elohe yisrael o bemi sheshshemo channun o bemi sheshshemo rachum sheeni chayyav laze kelum. vechen im amar hare hu arur laAdonai o arur lemi sheshshemo channun im yesh laze etzli kelum: 
Vechetzad mippi haddayyanin. kegon sheamru lo mashbiin anu otcha baAdonai elohe yisrael o bemi sheshshemo channun sheen laze beyadcha kelum vehu one amen. o sheamru hare peloni ben peloni arur laAdonai elohe yisrael o lemi sheshshemo channun im yesh lifloni etzlo mamon velo yode lo vehu one amen zo hi shevuat haddayyanin: 
Haddayyanin shehishbiu belo nekitat chefetz beyado hare ellu toim. vechozer venishba vesefer tora beyado. veim achaz tefillin beyado vehishbiuhu eno chozer venishba shehare achaz tora beyado uchemo sefer hen. hishbiuhu meyushshav eno chozer venishba: 
Talmid chacham lechattechilla mashbiin oto meyushshav utefillin beyado veeno tzarich littol sefer tora ella tefillin bechappo chefetz hu venishba bilshon hakkodesh kemo shebbearnu: 
En ben shevuat hesset lishvuat haddayyanin ella nekitat chefetz. sheen hannishba shevuat hesset ochez sefer tora ella mashbiin oto beshem o bechinnuy bishvua o beala mippiv o mippi bet din kemo shevuat haddayyanin. uchevar nahagu hakkol lihyot sefer tora beyad chazzan hakkeneset o shear haam beet shemmashbiin shevuat hesset kede leayyem alav: 
Haddayyanin shehishbiu et hannishba bechol lashon shehu makkir hare zo kemitzvatah vechen horu haggeonim. aval rabbotenu horu sheen mashbiim ella bilshon hakkodesh. veen rauy lismoch al horaa zo. veaf al pi shennahagu bechol batte dinin lehishshava bilshon hakkodesh tzarich lehodia et hannishba ad sheyyehe makkir leshon hashshevua. sheshshevuat haddayyanin hi shevuat happikkadon beatzmah. veaf shevuat hesset nahagu kol haam lehashebia otah bilshon hakkodesh: 
Kol mi sheyyitchayyev shevuat haddayyanin shehi al yede taanat vadday uchefira ben shehayta middivre tora ben shehayta middivrehem meayyemin alav kemo sheyyitbaer. vechol mi sheyyitchayyev bah betaanat safek ben min hattora ben middivrehem eno tzarich iyyum: 
Vechetzad meayyemin al hannishba. omrin lo heve yodea shekkol haolam kullo nizdaazea beshaa sheamar hakkadosh baruch hu lemoshe lo tissa et shem Adonai elohecha lashshav. vechol averot shebbattora neemar bahen venakke vechan neemar <small>(Shemot 20 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 11)</small> "lo yenakke". kol averot shebbattora nifrain mimmennu vechan mimmennu umimmishpachto shemmechappin al ze. velo od ella gorem lehippara missonehem shel yisrael shekkol yisrael arevin ze baze shenneemar <small>(Hoshea 4 2)</small> "alo vechachesh veratzoach" vegomer vechatuv acharav <small>(Hoshea 4 3)</small> "al ken teeval haaretz veumlal kol yoshev bah". kol averot shebbattora tolin lo shenayim ushelosha dorot im yesh lo zechut vechan nifrain miyyad shenneemar <small>(Zecharya 5 4)</small> "hotzetiha neum Adonai tzevaot uvaa el bet haggannav veel bet hannishba bishmi lashshaker". hotzetiha miyyad. uvaa el bet haggannav ze haggonev daat habberiyyot veen lo mamon al chavero vetoano bechinnam umashbio. el bet hannishba bishmi lashsheker kemashmao. <small>(Zecharya 5 4)</small> "vechillattu veet etzav veet avanav" devarim sheen esh umayim mechallin otan shevuat sheker mechalla otan: 
Veinyan haiyyum hazze kullo belashon shehen makkirin omrim lahem kede sheyyavinu baddevarim veyachzor hachote lemutav. amar eni nishba potrin oto venoten ma shettaano chavero. vechen im amar hattoen eni mashbio ufetaro holchin lahen: 
Amar hareni nishba vachavero tovea. haomdim sham omrim ze laze <small>(Bamidbar 16 26)</small> "suru na meal ohole haanashim harshaim" vegomer. veomrin lo lo al datecha anu mashbiin otcha ella al datenu veal daat bet din: 
Af al pi sheen meayyemin iyyum ze bishvuat taanat safek kemo shebbearnu velo bishvuat hesset. tzerichin haddayyanin liftzor bevaale dinin ulay yachzeru bahen ad shello tihye sham shevua kelal: 
Davar barur vegaluy shekkol hannishba shevuat haddayyanin o shevuat hesset besheker sheyyehe chayyav mishshum shevuat happikkadon shekkevar nitbaaru mishpateha veeno loke veaf al pi shehu mezid venitchayyev leshallem ma shennishba alav betosefet chomesh shehu revia hakkeren ad sheyyihye hu vechumsho chamishsha. umevi karban asham im yesh sham bet (din) kemo shebbearnu:
Mishneh Torah, Oaths 12:
Af al pi shelloke hannishibba lashshav o lashsheker vechen hannishba shevuat haedut o shevuat happikkadon mevi karban. en mitkapper lahen avon hashshevua kullo shenneemar <small>(Shemot 20 7)</small> <small>(Devarim 5 11)</small> "lo yenakke Adonai" en laze nikkayon middin shamayim ad sheyyitpara mimmennu al hashshem haggadol shechillel. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 19 12)</small> "vechillalta et shem Adonai elohecha ani Adonai". lefichach tzarich adam lehizzaher meavon ze yoter mikkol haaverot: 
Avon ze min hachamurot hu kemo shebbearnu behilchot teshuva. af al pi sheen bo lo karet velo mitat bet din yesh bo chillul hashshem hamekuddash shehu gadol mikkol haavonot: 
Mi shennishba bashshamayim uvaaretz uvashshemesh vechayyotze bahen af al pi sheen kavvanato ella lemi shebberaam en zo shevua. vechen hannishba benavi min hanneviim o bichtav mikkitve hakkodesh af al pi sheen kavvanato ella lemi sheshshalach navi ze o lemi shetztzivva bichtav ze en zo shevua. veaf al pi sheen ellu shevuot meayyemin alehen umelammedin et haam shello yinhagu kallut rosh bechach umarin beenehem shezzo shevua. ufotchin lahem petach umattirin lahem: 
Bamme devarim amurim bishar kitve hakkodesh. aval hannishba battora. im nishba bema shekkatuv bah dato al hahazkarot. veim nishba bah setam dato al haggevil veen kan shevua. netalah beyado venishba bah hare ze kemi shennishba bema shekkatuv bah veasur: 
Vehannishba battora setam im talmid chacham hu eno tzarich sheela lechacham. veim am haaretz hu tzarich sheela lechacham kede shello yinhag kallut rosh bishvuot: 
Eved shennishba en rabbo tzarich lichpoto. vahare hu achar shennishba kekodem shennishba. lefi sheen gufo kanuy lo kede shettachul alav shevuato veneemar bishvuot <small>(Bamidbar 30 3)</small> "lesor issar al nafsho" mi shennafsho birshuto yatza eved shehu birshut acherim. venimtza ze kemo shennishba al nichse acher: 
Ketannim shennishbeu vehen yodin taam hashshevua af al pi sheenan chayyavin. kofin otan laamod bedivrehen. kede lechannechan uleayyem alehem kede shello yinhagu kallut rosh bishvuot. veim haya haddavar shennishbeu alav davar sheen hakkatan yachol laamod bo ella im ken nizzak. kegon shennishba sheyyatzum o shello yochal basar zeman merubbe. makke oto aviv o rabbo vegoer bo umarin lo shehuttera shevuato kede shello yihye ragil lehakel rosh bishvuot: 
Tzarich lehizzaher bakketannim harebe ulelammed leshonam divre emet belo shevua kede shello yihyu regilim lehishshava tamid keakkum. veze haddavar kemo chova al avotehem veal melammede tinokot: 
Hashshomea hazekarat hashshem mippi chavero lashshav o shennishba lefanav lashsheker o shebberech beracha sheenah tzericha shehu over mishshum nose shem Adonai lashshav kemo shebbearnu behilchot berachot hare ze chayyav lenaddoto. veim lo niddahu hu beatzmo yehe benidduy. vetzarich lehattir oto miyyad kede shello yehe michshol laacherim shehare eno yodea shennidduhu. veim tomar yodio nimtzeu kol haolam benidduy shehare limdu leshonam haave ushevua tamid: 
Bamme devarim amurim beshehaya hannishba hazze o hamevarech levattala mezid. aval im haya shogeg velo yada shezze asur eno chayyav lenaddoto. vaani omer sheasur lenaddoto shello anash hakkatuv shogeg ella mazhiro umatre bo shello yachzor: 
Velo shevua lashshav bilvad hi sheasura ella afillu lehazekir shem min hashshemot hameyuchadin levattala asur veaf al pi shello nishba. shehare hakkatuv metzavve veomer <small>(Devarim 28 58)</small> "leyira et hashshem hannichbad vehannora". uvichlal yirato shello yazkiro levattala. lefichach im taa hallashon vehotzi shem levattala yemaher miyyad vishabbeach vifaer vihadder lo kede shello yizzacher levattala. ketzad. amar Adonai, omer baruch hu leolam vaed o gadol hu umehullal meod vechayyotze baze, kede shello yehe levattala: 
Af al pi shemmuttar lehishshael al hashshevua kemo shebbearnu veen baze dofi. umi shellibbo nokfo bedavar ze eno ella shemetz minut. af al pi chen rauy lehizzaher bedavar ze. veen nizkakin lehattir ella mippene devar mitzva o mippene tzorech gadol. vetova gedola hi leadam shello yishshava kelal. veim avar venishba sheyyitztaer vayyaamod bishvuato shenneemar <small>(Tehillim 15 4)</small> "nishba lehara velo yamir" vechatuv acharav <small>(Tehillim 15 5)</small> "ose elle lo yimmot leolam": seliku lehu hilchot shevuot besiyata dishmayya
Mishneh Torah, Offerings for Those with:
Arvaa hen hannikrain mechussere kappara. hazzava. vehayyoledet. vehazzav. vehametzora. velamma nikrau mechussere kappara shekkol echad mehen af al pi shettahar mittumato vetaval veheeriv shimsho adayin hu chaser velo gamra tohorato kede leechol bekadashim ad sheyyavi karbano. vekodem sheyyavi kapparato asur hu leechol bekadashim kemo shebbearnu bifsule hammukdashin:
Ger shemmal vetaval vaadayin lo hevi karbano. af al pi shehu asur leechol bekadashim ad sheyyavi karbano eno mimmechussere kappara. shekkarbano ikkevo lihyot ger gamur velihyot kechol keshere yisrael umippene ze eno ochel bekadashim sheadayin lo naasa kichshere yisrael. vechevan sheyyavi karbano veyease yisrael kasher ochel bekadashim. hevi pereda achat beshacharit ochel bekadashim laerev veyavi pereda sheniyya. shekkarbano shel ger olat behema o shene bene yona o shete torim ushenehen ola. kemo shebbearnu bemaase hakkarbanot:
Hazzav vehazzava karban kol achat mehen shete torim o shene bene yona echad ola veechad chattat. vehayyoledet karbanah keves ola uven yona o tor chattat. veim en yadah masseget mevia shete torim o shene bene yona echad ola veechad chattat. vehametzora karbano shelosha kevasim echad ola veechad asham. vechisba lechattat. veim en yado masseget mevi ken echad ola veechad chattat vecheves leasham:
Hazzav vehazzava vehametzora mevi kol echad mishshelashtan kapparato bayyom hashshemini letohorato shekkol echad mehen sofer shiva yeme tohora vetovel bayyom hashshevii umaariv shimsho umakriv karbenotav bayyom hashshemini:
Hayyoledet enah mevia karbanah beyom arbaim lezachar o beyom shemonim linkeva. ella maarevet shimshah umeviah karbanah lemachar shehu yom arbaim veechad lezachar veyom shemonim veechad linkeva vehu hayyom shenneemar bo <small>(Vayikra 12 6)</small> "uvimlot yeme tohorah leven o levat tavi" vegomer. veim hevia karbanah toch yeme melot lo yatzat afillu hevia al veladot harishonim betoch yeme melot shel valad ze lo yatzat. avru yamim ellu velo heviu kapparatan hare ellu makrivin kapparatan leachar zeman. vechol zeman shello hikrivu chattatam asurim leechol bekadashim. aval haola (vehaasham) enan meakkevin. kevar bearnu bemaase hakkarbanot shekkol mechuyyeve karban en makrivin al yadan ella middatan. chutz mimmechussere kappara sheen tzerichin daat bealim shehare adam mevi karban al banav uvenotav hakketannim im hayu mechussere kappara umaachilan bizvachim:
E zo hi zava. zo shezzav damah shelosha yamim ze achar ze belo et niddatah. vezo hi zava gedola shetztzericha sefirat shiva vechayyevet bekarban. uchevar bearnu beinyan hannidda ematay tihye haishsha zava bedamim shettire veematay lo tihye zava ella nidda o tehora umatay tihye sefek zava. kol makom sheamarnu shehi zava vesoferet shiva hare hi chayyevet lehavi karban vechattatah neechelet. vechol makom sheamarnu shehi sefek zava hare zo mevia karban veen chattata neechelet. shekkevar bearnu shechattat haof habbaa al hassafek tissaref. vesham bearnu ma teled haishsha o ma tappil vetihye temea leda uma teled o tappil velo tihye temea leda. vechol makom sheamarnu shehi temea leda hare zo mevia karban vechattatah neechelet. vechol makom sheamarnu sheenah temea leda hare zo petura min hakkarban:
Haishsha shello huchzeka ebbara vehippila velo yada ma hippila. im nefel shechayyevet alav karban o davar sheenah chayyevet alav karban. hare zo sefek yoledet umeviah karban veen chattata neechelet. vechen shete nashim shehippilu shene nefalim nefel echad rauy lehakeriv alav vehannefel haacher petura alav veen achat mehen makkeret niflah. kol achat mishshetehen mevia karban missafek veen chattat achat mishshetehen neechelet shechattat haof habbaa al hassafek nisrefet shemma enah chayyevet venimtzet chattat zo chullin shennishchatu baazara shehen asurin bahanaa kemo shebbearnu behilchot shechita:
Achat hayyoledet veachat hammappelet valad echad o veladot harebe hare zo mevia karban echad lechullan vehu shetteled kullan betoch yeme melot. aval im hippila achar yeme melot mevia af al hashsheni. ketzad. yalda nekeva kol nefalim shettappil miyyom halleda ad sof yom shemonim hare hen nechshavin im havvalad harishon ucheillu yalda teomim ze achar ze veenah mevia ella karban echad. hippila nefel beyom shemonim veechad umiyyom echad ushemonim vahala im hi reuya lekarban hare zo mevia alav bifne atzmo. yalda nekeva uleachar shishshim o shivim yom hippila nekeva sheniyya. kol nefel shettappil betoch shemonim shel nekeva zo hashsheniyya petura alav. vechen im hippila nekeva shelishit achar shishshim o shivim yom shel nekeva sheniyya. hare kol nefel shettappil betoch shemonim shel nekeva shelishit petura alav mippene shehu chashuv im hannefel hashshelishi vehannefel hashshelishi chashuv im hashsheni mippene shehu betoch yeme melot shello vehashsheni chashuv im harishona veenah mevia ella karban echad al hakkol:
Hayyoledet tumtum o anderoginus vehippila nefel achar arbaim miyyom ledato. hare zo mevia karban al nefel ze shemma zachar hu harishon vahare hippila achar melot. veen chattatah neechelet shemma nekeva hi harishona uvetoch melot hippila shehi petura mikkarban sheni:
Haishsha sheyyesh aleha sefek chamesh ledot o sefek chamesh zivot. mevia karban echad veochelet bizvachim veen hashshear aleha chova. hayu aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot vechamesh zavot vaddaot mevia karban echad veochelet bizvachim vehashshear aleha chova. vechen haddin bezav. hayu aleha chamesh ledot vaddaot vechamesh ledot safek o chamesh ledot vaddaot vechamesh zivot safek. mevia shene karbanot echad al havvadday veneechol ushear havvaddaot aleha chova veechad al hassafek veeno neechol veen hashshear aleha chova veochelet bizvachim:
Haishsha shennitgayyera veen yadua im ad shello nitgayyera yalda o mishshennitgayyera yalda. hare zo mevia karban missafek veen chattatah neechelet. kevar bearnu behilchot shegagot shekkol mechussere kappara missafek sheavar alehem [yom hakkippurim] chayyavin lehavi achar yom hakkippurim. shekkarban ze machshiran leechol bekadashim:
Haishsha sheyyesh aleha leda o ziva. mevia meot hakkinnim venotenet bashshofar veochelet bekadashim laerev chazaka sheen bet din shel kohanim omdin mishsham ad sheyyichlu kol hammaot shebbashshofar veyakrivu kenegdan kinnim. kemo shebbearnu bishkalim uvehilchot kele hammikdash vehaovdin bo:
Haishsha shehevia chattatah umeta yaviu hayyorshim olatah. af al pi shello hifrisha otah mechayyim kevar nishtaabbedu nechaseha lakkarban. vehashshibud din tora hu:

Hazav haamur battora hu shichvat zera habba mecholaye hachalalim shehi mitkabbetzet bahen. uchesheyyotze hazzov eno yotze bekoshi keshichvat zera veen bitziato taava velo hanaa ella nigrar veyotze kemo batzek shel seorim kehe keloven betza hammuzeret. aval shichvat zera levana keshura keloven betza sheenah muzeret:

Haroe reiyyot hazzov haggormot lo lihyot zav mechamat choli o ones vechayyotze bahen eno zav shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 2)</small> "zav mibbesaro" mechamat besaro hu sheyyihye tame lo mechamat davar acher. mikkan amru beshiva derachim bodkin et hazzav. bemaachol. uvemishte. bemassa. uvikfitza. becholi. uvemare. uvehirhur. ketzad. achal achila gassa o shata harebe. o sheachal o shata ochalin o mashkin hammeviin lide shichvat zera. o shennasa massoy kaved. o shekkafatz mimmakom lemakom uvichlal davar ze im hukka al gabbo. o shehaya chole. o sheraa ishsha vehitavva shechivatah. o shehirher beiske beila af al pi shello hirher bivilat ishsha shehu makkirah. im kadam echad mikkol ellu veraa reiyya shel zov tolin bo veeno metamme:

Haroe keri eno mittamme bezov meet leet sheriyya zo shel zov mechamat shichvat zera hi. vechen lemare ulehirhur tolin bahen meet leet. aval lemaachol ulemishte velikfitza ulemassa. tolin bahen kol zeman shemmitztaer:

Mi shemmal veachar kach raa zov ben akkum ben yisrael tolin bammila kol zeman shemmitztaer. akkum sheraa keri veachar kach nitgayyer metamme beziva miyyad veen tolin lo meet leet. katan en tolin lo lo bemare velo behirhur sheen lekatan mare vehirhur hammevi lide zov. lefichach bodkin oto bachamishsha derachim bilvad:

Ucheshem shettolin lekatan bechalyo kach tolin lo bocholi immo im haya yonek mimmenna o tzarich leimmo. bamme devarim amurim shebbodkin et hazzav bidrachim ellu biriyya sheniyya shel zov shebbah yease zav kemo sheyyitbaer. aval reiyya rishona afillu raa otah beones ureiyya sheniyya mechamat besaro hare ze tame tumat zivut. veaf al pi chen bodkin oto barishona kede limnot bah shalosh reiyyot lechayyevo karban. reiyya shelishit en bodkin oto bah ella afillu raa otah mechamat ones hoil venizkak letuma shehare reiyyot shennaasa bahen zav mechamat besaro haya lefichach yitchayyev bekarban:

Haroe reiyya achat shel zov hare hu kevaal keri. raa shetayim hare ze zov vetzarich sefirat shiva uviat mayim chayyim veeno chayyav bekarban. raa shalosh reiyyot hare ze zav gamur vechayyav bekarban. veen ben zav sheraa shete reiyyot leroe shalosh ella karban bilvad. udevarim ellu kullan divre kabbala mippi moshe rabbenu missinay:

Echad haroe shete reiyyot o shalosh beshaa achat zo achar zo o sheraa reiyya bechol yom ze achar ze hare ze zav. lefi shettala hakkatuv et hazzava beyamim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 25)</small> "ki yazuv zov damah yamim rabbim" vehazzav lo tala oto beyamim:

Veim hifsik hazzav ben reiyya liriyya yom gamur enan mitztarfot. ketzad. raa reiyya beshabbat ureiyya sheniyya besheni beshabbat enan mitztarfot veeno zav. vechen im raa reiyya sheniyya beechad beshabbat veraa reiyya shelishit bishlishi beshabbat eno chayyav bekarban sheen zo mitztarefet lishtayim shehare hifsik benehen yom echad. aval im raa achat hayyom veachat ballayla shelleacharav hare ellu mitztarfot. veen tzarich lomar sheim raa achat ballayla usheniyya bayyom shehen mitztarfot. vechen im raa shalosh reiyyot bishlosha lelot ze achar ze hare ellu mitztarfot:
Reiyyat hazzav en lah shiur ella haroe kol shehu tame shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 15 3)</small> "hechtim besaro" kol shehu. nikkar bivsaro metamme:

Haya hazzov nigrar veyotze velo pasak. im yesh mittechillat hariyya ad sofah kede tevila vesippug o yeter hare zo nechshevet kishte reiyyot hoil vehi arukka kishtayim. veim lo hayta arukka kashshiur hazze afillu pasak hazzov bentayim hare zo reiyya achat. vechen im hayta reiyya achat arukka keshalosh reiyyot shennimtza mittechillatah vead sofah kishte tevilot ushene sippugin hare zo nechshevet keshalosh reiyyot veyavi karban:

Raa reiyya achat bayyom vehifsik kede tevila vesippug veachar kach raa shetayim o achat arukka kishtayim o sheraa shetayim o achat merubba kishtayim vehifsik kede tevila vesippug veachar kach raa reiyya achat hare ze zav gamur:

Raa reiyya achat mikketzatah besof hayyom umiktzatah bitchillat hallayla af al pi sheenah arukka kishtayim hare ellu shete reiyyot shehayyamim mechallekin hariyya. lefichach haroe reiyya achat ben hashshemashot shehu safek min hayyom umin hallayla hare ze safek letuma:
Raa reiyya achat bayyom veachat ben hashshemashot hare ze vadday letuma vesafek lekarban umevi karban veeno neechol:

[Raa] reiyya achat ben hashshemashot [shel shabbat] ureiyya sheniyya ben hashshemashot shel motzae shabbat hare ze safek letuma vesafek lekarban. safek letuma shemma reiyya rishona hayta beerev shabbat usheniyya bemotzae shabbat vahare hifsik shabbat benehen veen kan zivut kelal. vahare hu safek lekarban shemma achat mehen hayta mikketzatah bayyom umiktzatah ballayla shehi chashuva kishtayim vahare raa shalosh reiyyot shehu chayyav bekarban. ulefichach mevi karban veeno neechol:

Kol hayyamim shehazzav roe bahen zivot hare hu tame. uchesheyyifsok hazzivot mone shiva yamim nekiyyim kezava vetovel bashshevii umaariv shimsho uvashshemini mevi karbano im haya baal shalosh reiyyot. veim raa reiyya shel zov afillu besof yom shevii achar shettaval satar hakkol umatchil limnot shiva yamim nekiyyim meachar yom reiyya haacharona:
Zav sheraa keri beechad mishshivat yeme hassefira eno soter ella yomo bilvad umashlim shiva yamim umevi karbano. ketzad. raa keri bayyom hachamishi sofer acharav shelosha yamim vetovel bashshelishi umevi karbano barvii:
Zav shebbadak beyom rishon mime hassefira umatza tahor velo badak kol shiva uvayyom hashshevii badak umatza tahor hare ze bechezkat tohora. afillu badak beyom hattuma atzmah umatza tahor ufasak hazzov velo badak lemachar bitchillat yeme hassefira uvadak bashshevii o bashshemini umatza tahor alu lo yeme hassefira vahare ze bechezkat tohora:
Kol reiyya shehi soteret enah mevia lide karban. ketzad. raa shete reiyyot vehifsik yom o yomayim vahare hu mone shiva yamim nekiyyim uvetoch hashshiva raa reiyya shel zov enah mitztarefet lishtayim ella soteret umatchil limnot kemo shebbearnu. afillu raa betoch yeme hassefira shalosh reiyyot zo achar zo. afillu raa otam beyom echad. afillu raa shalosh reiyyot besof yom shevii shel shiva yamim nekiyyim. eno mevi karban sheriyyot ellu listira hen. raa shalosh reiyyot belel shemini mevi karban sheen reiyyot ellu sotrin. bamme devarim amurim bezav baal shete reiyyot. aval bezav baal shalosh reiyyot belel shemini shelleachar shivat yamim nekiyyim eno mevi karban sheni al shalosh reiyyot ellu ella karban echad al hashshalosh harishonot. sheaf al pi sheen shalosh acharonot sotrot hare lo yatza lizman sherauy lekarban vehallayla mechussar zeman hu lakkol. chutz miyyoledet shehippila belel shemonim veechad shehi mevia karban sheni kemo shebbearnu. vedavar ze mippi hakkabbala:
Raa reiyya achat belel shemini ushete reiyyot beyom shemini hare ellu mitztarfin umevi karban sheni al zivot haacharonot. shehare reiyya rishona shel kol zav keshichvat zera hi chashuva veim raa achareha shetayim mitztarefet immahem lekarban. aval im raa shetayim belel shemini veachat beyom shemini en mitztarefet veeno mevi karban al hazziva zo haacharona:
Hakkol mittammein beziva afillu katan ben yomo vehaggerim vehaavadim vecheresh veshote. veyerae li shemmeviin alehen kappara kede lehaachilan bekadashim vechattatan neechelet shehare hen kekatan sheeno ben daat. useris adam useris chamma mittammein beziva kechol haanashim:
Hattumtum vehaanderoginus notnin alehen chumre haish vechumre haishsha. mittammein bedam kenashim uveloven kaanashim vetumatan besafek. lefichach im haya echad mehen baal shalosh reiyyot o zava sheraata dam shelosha yamim ze achar ze meviin karban veeno neechol. haya mone shiva yamim nekiyyim leloven veraa odem o leodem veraa loven hare ze eno soter:

Kesheyyitrappe hatztzarua mitztzarato achar shemmetaharin oto beetz erez veezov usheni tolaat ushete tzipporim umegallechin et kol besaro umatbilin oto achar kol zot yikkanes lirushalayim umone shivat yamim uvayyom hashshevii megalleach tiglachto sheniyya kattiglachat harishona vetovel vahare hu tevul yom umaariv shimsho ulemachar bashshemini tovel paam sheniyya veachar kach makrivin karbenotav. umippene ma tovel bashshemini achar shettovel meemesh. mippene shehaya ragil betuma bime chilluto veeno nizhar mishshum tuma veshemma nitma achar shettaval. lefichach tovel bashshemini beezrat hannashim belishkat hametzoraim sheshsham af al pi shello hissiach dato:
Nitacher velo gilleach bashshevii vegilleach bashshemini o achar kamma yamim bayyom sheyyegalleach yitbol veyaariv shimsho ulemachar yavi karbenotav achar sheyyitbol paam sheniyya kemo shebbearnu. ketzad osin lo. hametzora omed chutz leezrat yisrael keneged petach mizrachit beaskuppat shaar nikanor ufanav lemaarav vesham omdim kol mechussere kappara beet shemmetaharin otan vesham mashkin et hassotot. vehakkohen lokeach asham shel metzora keshehu chay umenifo im log hashshemen bammizrach kederech kol hattenufot. veim henif ze bifne atzmo veze bifne atzmo yatza. veachar kach mevi et haasham shel metzora ad happetach umachnis shete yadav laazara vesomech alav veshochatin oto miyyad. umekabbelin shene kohanim et damo. echad mekabbel bichli vezorko al gabbe hammizbeach veechad beyado hayemanit umeare leyado hassemalit umazze beetzbao hayemanit. veim shinna vekibbel bismol techilla pasal. hakkohen shekkibbel miktzat haddam bichli molicho vezorko al hammizbeach techilla. veachar kach yavo hakkohen shekkibbel haddam bechappo etzel hametzora. hakkohen mibbifnim vehametzora mibbachutz. umachnis hametzora rosho venoten hakkohen min haddam shebbechappo al tenuch azno hayemanit. veachar kach yachnis yado hayemanit veyitten al bohen yado veachar kach yachnis raglo hayemanit veyitten al bohen raglo veim natan al hassemol lo yatza. veachar kach yakriv chattato veolato. veachar sheyyitten haddam al habbehonot notel hakkohen millog hashshemen veyotzek letoch chappo shel chavero hassemalit veim yatzak letoch kaf atzmo yatza. vetovel etzbao hayemanit bashshemen shebbechappo umazze sheva peamim keneged bet kodesh hakodashim al kol hazaya tevilat etzba beshemen. veim hizza velo kivven keneged bet kodesh hakodashim kesherot. veachar kach yavo etzel hametzora veyitten min hashshemen al mekom dam haasham bitnuch ozen uvohen yado uvohen raglo. vehannotar min hashshemen shebbechappo yittenennu al rosh hammittaher veim lo natan lo kipper. ushear hallog mitchallek lakkohanim:
Sheyare hallog eno neechol ella baazara lezichre kehunna kishar kadshe kadashim shehare hukkash leasham. veasur leechol millog hashshemen ad sheyyitten mimmennu mattan sheva umattan behonot veim achal loke keochel kadashim kodem zerika:

E zehu tenuch ozen ze gader haemtzai. natan al tzidde habbehonot kasher. natan al tzidde tziddehen pasul. ben shennatan hashshemen al dam haasham atzmo milmala ben shennatan betzad haddam afillu nitkanneach haddam kodem sheyyitten hashshemen al behonot yatza shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 28)</small> "al mekom dam haasham". en lo bohen yad yemanit o bohen regel yemanit o sheen lo ozen yemanit en lo tohora olamit:
Asham metzora sheshshechato shello lishmo o shello natan middamo al gabbe behonot hare ze ole lammizbeach vetaun nesachim keniske asham metzora vetzarich hametzora asham acher lehacheshiro:
Hikdim chattato laashamo lo yihye acher memares bedamah ella teebbar tzuratah vetetze levet hasserefa:
Yesh leadam lehavi ashamo hayyom velogo achar asara yamim. veim ratza leshannot hallog laasham metzora acher meshanne af al pi shekkadash bichli. chasar hallog ad shello yatzak yemalleennu. chasar meachar sheyyatzak yavi acher battechilla:
Yatzak min hashshemen lechappo vehitchil lehazzot venishpach hallog im ad shello gamar mattan sheva nishpach hallog yavi acher veyatchil bemattan sheva. gamar mattan sheva venishpach hallog yavi acher veyatchil lechattechilla babbehonot. hitchil babbehonot venishpach hallog kodem sheyyigmor yavi acher veyatchil lechattechilla babbehonot. gamar habbehonot veachar kach nishpach hallog kodem sheyyitten shear hashshemen shebbechappo al rosh hammittaher eno tzarich lehavi log acher shemmattenat harosh enah meakkevet shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 18)</small> "vehannotar bashshemen" <small>(Vayikra 14 17)</small> "umiyyeter hashshemen":
Hikdim mattan shemen lemattan dam yemalle hallog shemen veyachzor veyitten hashshemen achar haddam. hikdim mattan shemen al habbehonot lemattan sheva yemalle hallog veyachzor veyitten al habbehonot achar mattan sheva shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 14 2)</small> "zot tihye torat hametzora" shettihye kol torato al hasseder:
Natan sheva hammattanot shello lishman lo hurtza vehuchshar hametzora:
Metzora shennitnaggea achar shehevi ashamo tzarich karban acher letzaraat sheniyya. vechen im hevi ashamo venitnaggea tzarich karban al kol achat veachat. aval im nitnaggea venirpa vehevi tzipporav vechazar venitnaggea venitrappe vehevi tzipporav karban echad lechullan:
Metzora shehevi karban ani veheeshir o ashir veheeni kodem sheyyakriv karbenotav hakkol holech achar haasham. im haya bishat shechitat haasham ashir yeshallem karban ashir veim haya ani yeshallem karban ani:
Shene metzoraim shennitarvu karbenotehen venizrak dam achat mishshete hachattaot shellahen veachar kach met echad min hametzoraim ketzad ose ze hametzora hachay. lehavi chattat behema eno yachol shemma zo shennizrak damah chattato hi veen meviin chattat behema al hassafek. ulehavi chattat haof eno yachol sheashir shehevi karban ani lo yatza. vechetzad yaase. yichtov kol nechasav leacher venimtza ani veyavi chattat haof missafek velo teachel kemo shebbearnu venimtza ochel bekadashim:
Ashir sheamar karbano shel metzora ze alav vehametzora haya ani hare ze mevi al yado karbenot ashir shehare yad hannoder masseget. veani sheamar karbano shel metzora ze alay vehaya hametzora ashir hare ze mevi al yado karbenot ashir shehare ze hannoder chayyav bekarbenot ashir:
Mishneh Torah, Offerings for Unintention: Kol haover bishgaga al achat mimmitzvot lo taase sheyyesh bah maase shechayyavin aleha karet. hare ze chayyav lehakeriv karban chattat. umitzvat ase sheyyakriv chattato al shiggato:

Vechol avera shechayyavin al zedonah karet chayyavin al shiggatah chattat chutz mishshalosh averot. megaddef. umevattel mila. vekarban pesach. happesach vehammila mippene shehen mitzvat ase vechattat en meviin ella al shiggat lo taase shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 13)</small> "achat mikkol mitzvot Adonai asher lo teasena". vehamegaddef mippene sheen bo maase veneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 29)</small> "laose bishgaga" yatza megaddef sheen bo maase. lefichach hamekabbel avoda zara beloah af al pi shehu chayyav karet im haya mezid niskal veim kibbel bishgaga patur min hakkarban lefi shello asa maase veneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 27)</small> "baasotah achat":

Kol keretot shebbattora chutz mishshalosh keretot shebbearnu im avar hayyachid al achat mehen bishgaga mevi chattat kevua chutz mittame sheachal kodesh vetame shennichnas lammikdash sheshshenehem en meviin chattat kevua ella karban ole veyored kemo sheyyitbaer:

Chattat kevua hi habbaa min habbehema bilvad vekarban ole veyored hu karban sheeno kavua ella im haya ashir mevi chattat behema veim haya ani mevi of o asirit haefa kemo sheyyitbaer. nimtzeta lamed shekkol haaverot shehayyachid mevi al shiggatan chattat kevua arbaim veshalosh. veellu hen: 1) habba al immo. 2) habba al em ishto. 3) habba al em immah. 4) habba al em aviha. 5) habba al bitto. 6) habba al bat bitto. 7) habba al bat beno. 8) habba al bat ishto. 9) habba al bat bittah. 10) habba al bat benah. 11) habba al achoto. 12) habba al achoto shehi bat eshet aviv. 13) habba al achot aviv. yad) habba al achot immo. 15) habba al achot ishto. 16) habba al eshet aviv. 17) habba al eshet achi aviv. 18) habba al eshet beno. 19) habba al eshet achiv. 20) habba al eshet ish. ka) habba al hannidda. 22) hashshochev im zachar. 23) habba al aviv. kad) habba al achi aviv. ko) hashshochev im behema. 26) haishsha shemmeviah aleha et habbehema. nimtzeu kol keretot shebbaarayot esrim veshesh. uvishar haaverot sheva esre. veellu hen: 1) haoved avoda zara bemaase. 2) hannoten mizzaro lammolech. 3) baal ov. 4) baal yiddeoni bemaase. 5) hamechallel et hashshabbat. 6) haose melacha beyom hakkippurim. 7) haochel veshote beyom hakkippurim. 8) haochel notar. 9) haochel chametz befesach. 10) haochel chelev. 11) haochel dam. 12) haochel piggul. 13) hashshochet kadashim chutz laazara. yad) hammaale karban chutz laazara. 15) hamefattem et shemen hammishcha. 16) hamefattem et hakketoret. 17) hassach beshemen hammishcha. hare ellu arbaim veshalosh averot shemmeviin al shiggatan chattat kevua. uma hu hakkarban shemmevi hashshogeg beachat meellu. im shagag baavoda zara mevi ez bat shenatah lechattat vehi haamura befarashat shelach lecha ben shehaya hachote hedyot o melech o kohen gadol o meshuach milchama hakkol shavin beshiggat avoda zara. aval im shagag beachat mishshear arbaim ushetayim im haya hedyot mevi seirat izzim o nekeva min hakkevasim vezo hi chattat shel echad meam haaretz haamura befarashat vayyikra. veim hammelech hu sheshshagag beachat mehen mevi seirat izzim lechattat. veim kohen mashuach hu mevi par ben bakar lechattat vehu nisraf kemo shennitparesh sham:

Echad yachid sheshshagag beachat meellu o merubbin shenneemar <small>(Bamidbar 15 29)</small> "tora achat tihye lachem laosho bishgaga". ketzad. anshe medina sheshshaggu vedimmu shehayyom chol vahare hu yom hakkippurim vechullan achlu veasu melacha. kol echad mehen mevi shete chattaot kevasot o seirot. vechen im shaggu kullan vehiktiru laavoda zara kol echad veechad min haovdim mevi ez bat shenatah lechattat:

En adam chayyav chattat al shiggato ad sheyyihye shogeg mittechilla vead sof aval im shagag battechilla vehezid bassof o hezid battechilla veshagag bassof patur mikkarban chattat. ketzad. kegon shehotzi chefetz mershut lirshut beshabbat akar bezadon vehinniach bishgaga o sheakar bishgaga vehinniach bezadon patur ad sheyyaakor bishgaga veyanniach bishgaga. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Avar avera veyodea shehi belo taase aval eno yodea shechayyavin aleha karet hare zo shegaga umevi chattat. aval im yada shehi becharet veshagag bekarban velo yada im chayyavin aleha karban im lav hare ze mezid. sheshshiggat karban enah shegaga baaverot ellu shechayyavin alehen karet:

Mi shello noda lo atzmo shel chet shechata. af al pi sheyyada bevadday sheavar al lo taase sheyyesh bo karet. hare ze patur mikkarban chattat. shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 23)</small> "asher chata bah" ad sheyyeda hachet shechata bo. ketzad. chelev venotar lefanav veachal et echad mehem veen yadua e ze achal. ishto nidda vaachoto babbayit veshagag uva al achat mehen veen yadua e zo mehen baal. shabbat veyom hakkippurim lefanav veasa melacha beechad mehen veen yadua bee ze mehen asa hare ze patur mikkarban chattat:
Chata venoda lo chattato vechazar ushechacho hare ze mevi chattat leshem ma shehu veteachel kishar chattaot hanneechalot:

Shagag beshem echad vehem shene gufin chayyav. ketzad. shete niddot veshagag beachat mehen veen yadua e zo hi. shete achayot veshagag beachat mehen veen yadua e zo hi chayyav chattat shehare yada atzmo shel chet. lema ze dome lishte nerot dolkot shekkibba achat mehen veen yadua e zo ner hi. o lishne tamchuyin shel chelev sheachal meechad mehen veen yadua mee ze tamchuy mehen achal shehu chayyav. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Kol hamechuyyav chattat kevua al shiggato veasa bishgaga venoda lo achar shechata af al pi shello hayta lo yedia battechilla shezze chet hu hare ze chayyav chattat. ketzad. tinok shennishba leven haakkum vegadal vehu eno yodea ma hem yisrael velo datam veasa melacha beshabbat veachal chelev vedam vechayyotze bahen. kesheyyivvada lo shehu yisrael vmtzuvve al kol ellu chayyav lehavi chattat al kol avera vaavera. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hashshogeg belo kavvana baarayot o bemaachalot asurot chayyav chattat. beshabbat patur mechattat. ketzad. haya mitassek im ishsha uvealah belo kavvana livila vahare hi erva alav. dimma shezze shebbefiv rok hu uvelao belo kavvana leshem achila baolam vahare hu chelev hare ze chayyav chattat. nitkavvin lehagebiah et hattalush vechatach et hamechubbar belo kavvana lachatichato patur. melechet machashevet asra tora kemo shebbearnu bimkomo:

Kol haose mitzva min hammitzvot uvichlal asiyyatah naaset avera shechayyavin aleha karet bishgaga hare ze patur mechattat mippene sheasa birshut. ketzad. habba al yevimto vahare hi nidda vehu lo yada. hare ze patur mechattat shehare asaah birshut. aval im ba al ishto vahare hi nidda chayyav chattat mippene shello shealah veachar kach yivol. aval yevimto eno ragil bah kede sheyyishal lah. vechen mi shehayu lo shene tinokot echad lamul beshabbat veechad lamul beerev shabbat o beechad beshabbat veshachach umal shenehen beshabbat. patur mechattat shehare yesh lo reshut lamul echad mehen beshabbat veshabbat dechuya hi etzlo umitzva asa af al pi shehem shene gufin hoil uzemanno bahul eno medakdek. aval im lo haya echad mehen rauy lamul beshabbat veshachach umal beshabbat mi sheeno rauy lamul beshabbat chayyav chattat:

Umman shebba lamul lifnot hayyom beyom hashshabbat veamru lo lo nishar penay bayyom kede shettamul veim tatchil lamul lo tashlim ad yetziat hashshabbat venimtzeta chovel beshabbat velo ose mitzva. veamar ragil ani vezariz uvimhera amul. im lo hishlim ella ad yetziat hashshabbat hare ze chayyav chattat shehare hitru bo:

Hammotzi et hallulav beyom tov harishon shel chag shechal lihyot beshabbat kede letzet bo veheeviro arba ammot birshut harabbim beshogeg patur shehare birshut hotzi. vechen hashshochet et happesach beyom arbaa asar shechal lihyot beshabbat venoda lo achar ken shemmashchu habbealim et yedehem o shemmetu o nitmeu kodem shechita. o shennimtza terefa basseter kegon nekuv meayim o rea. hare ze patur mippene sheshshachat birshut. aval nimtza baal mum o shehayta terefa geluya hare ze chayyav chattat mippene shehaya lo livdok veachar kach yishchot. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Shachat et happesach beshabbat shello lishmo betaut patur mippene shehazzevach kasher sheakirat shemo betaut eno akira kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin:

Shachat zevachim acherim leshem pesach betaut. im reuyin hem lekarban pesach patur mikkarban chattat mippene sheshshachat birshut. im enan reuyin kegon shehayta nekeva o ben shetayim chayyav chattat shehare eno rauy lekarban pesach. vechen im shagag ushechato beshabbat shello leochlav o shello limnuyav o laarelim o litmeim chayyav chattat. shechato leochlav veshello leochlav limnuyav veshello limnuyav lemulim velaarelim litmeim velithorim patur. shehare happesach kasher. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Hashshochet beshabbat karban tzibbur shello lishmo hare ze chayyav chattat veyaktir emurim laerev. vechen im shachat yeter al chovat hayyom chayyav chattat al hattosefet:

Shachat karbenot yachid sheen dochim et hashshabbat beshabbat bishgaga chayyav chattat vehabbasar muttar bahanaa. veen zorkin et haddam. veim avar vezarak damam lishman ben beshogeg ben bemezid alu labbealim leshem chova. veyaktir emurin laerev vehabbasar yeachel veyavi hashshochet chattat al shiggato:

Hayu lefanav shete behemot shel tzibbur achat kechusha veachat shemena vehayta chovat hayyom beachat ben chattat ben ola veshagag veshachat hashshetayim. im shachat kechusha battechilla veachar kach shachat hashshemena patur mikkarban chattat velo od ella sheomrim lo have shemena ushechot lechattechilla. aval im shachat hashshemena techilla veachar kach hakkechusha chayyav chattat al hattosefet. nimtzet harishona hashshemena terefa bivne meayim af al pi shello yada shehi terefa beet sheshshachat hakkechusha velo laze nitkavven hoil venishchata haacharona kemitzvatah hare ze patur mechattat. vechen happores metzuda lehaalot dagim min hayyam bishgaga veheela tinok im haddagim ben sheshshama shettava tinok ben shello shama hoil veheela tinok hare ze patur mechattat af al pi shello hayta kavvanato ella latzud mippene shehaya shogeg. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi shehaya lefanav belele happesach tzali shel pesach venotar min hakkadashim venitkavven leechol tzali shehu mitzva veshagag veachal hannotar hare ze chayyav chattat shehare lo asa mitzva baachila zo. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Mi sheheidu alav edim shechata chet shechayyavin alav chattat kevua velo hitru bo ella amru reinucha sheasita melacha beshabbat o sheachalta chelev vehu omer ani yodea bevadday shello asiti davar ze. eno chayyav chattat hoil veim yomar mezid hayiti yippater min hakkarban kesheamar lahen lo achalti velo asiti naasa keomer lo achalti bishgaga ella bezadon shehu patur min hakkarban velo hichchish et haedim:
Shatak velo hiflig et haedim (ella) afillu amra lo ishsha achalta chelev o asita melacha beshabbat veshatak chayyav lehavi chattat. amar lo ed echad chelev hu ze veshatak. vechazar vaachalo bishgaga mevi chattat. veim hitru bo loke alav. af al pi sheikkar haedut beed echad:
Kevar bearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin shehammafrish chattato al hachelev sheachal lo yevienna al hashshabbat shechillel o al haddam sheachal shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 4 28)</small> "vehevi karbano seirat izzim" vegomer <small>(Vayikra 4 28)</small> "al chattato asher chata" ad sheyyihye karbano leshem cheto lo sheyyakrivenna mechet al chet. veim hikriv pesalah. yeter al ze amru hifrish chattato al chelev sheachal emesh lo yevienna al chelev sheachal hayyom veim hevi kipper. veen tzarich lomar sheim hifrishah aviv umet vehaya habben mechuyyav beoto hachet shello yevienna habben al cheto kemo shennitbaer sham:
Hammevi chattat al shene chataim tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi bidme chetzyah lechet ze uvidme chetzyah lachet hashsheni. vechen shenayim sheheviu chattat achat al shene chataehem tire ad sheyyippol bah mum vetimmacher veyavi ze chattato bidme chetzyah veyavi ze chattato bidme chetzyah:
Hevi shete chattaot al chet echad yakriv e zo sheyyirtze vehashsheniyya tire ad sheyyippol bah mum veyippelu dameha lindava:
Hevi shete chattaot al shene chataim zo tishshachet leshem chet haechad vehashsheniyya leshem hachet hashsheni:
Kevar bearnu behilchot maase hakkarbanot shehammumar laavoda zara o lechallel shabbatot befarhesya en mekabbelin mimmennu karban kelal. vehammumar laavera mishshear averot en mekabbelin mimmennu chattat al oto hachet. ketzad. mumar leechol chelev sheachal chelev bishgaga vehevi chattato en mekabbelin mimmennu ad sheyyachazor bitshuva. afillu haya mumar leechol chelev leteavon venitchallef lo chelev beshumman vaachalo vehevi karban en mekabbelin mimmennu. shemmishsheachal bezadon ben lehacheis ben leteavon hare hu mumar. haya mumar leechol chelev veshagag veachal dam mekabbelin mimmennu kemo shebbearnu:
Mi sheshshagag vehifrish chattato veachar kach naasa mumar vechazar bitshuva o nishtatta vechazar venishtappa. af al pi shennidcha hakkarban bentayim hare ze chazar venira sheen baale chayyim nidchin kemo shebbearnu behilchot pesule hammukdashin lefichach yakrivenna atzmah. ucheshem sheim nolad bo mum over venitrappe yachzor lechashruto kach im niddechu habbealim vechazru veniru yikkarev:
Chayyave chattaot vaashamot vaddaim sheavar alehen yom hakkippurim chayyavin lehavi leachar yom hakkippurim. vechayyave ashamot teluyin peturin shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 16 30)</small> "mikkl chattotechem lifne Adonai titharu". kach lamdu mippi hashshemua shekkol chet sheen makkir bo ella Adonai nitkapper lo. lefichach mi shebba al yado sefek avera beyom hakkippurim afillu im chashecha patur measham taluy shekkol hayyom mechapper. nimtzeta lamed sheen meviin al lo hoda shel yom hakkippurim asham taluy ella im lo kipper lo yom hakkippurim kemo sheyyitbaer:
En yom hakkippurim velo hachattat velo haasham mechapperin ella al hashshavim hammaaminim bechapparatan. aval hamevaet bahen enan mechapperin bo. ketzad. haya mevaet vehevi chattato o ashamo vehu omer o mechashshev belibbo sheen ellu mechapperin. af al pi shekkarvu kemitzvatan lo nitkapper lo uchesheyyachazor bitshuva mibbeitato tzarich lehavi chattato vaashamo. vechen hamevaet beyom hakkippurim en yom hakkippurim mechapper alav. lefichach im nitchayyev beasham taluy veavar alav yom hakkippurim vehu mevaet bo hare ze lo nitkapper lo uchesheyyachazor bitshuva achar yom hakkippurim chayyav lehavi kol asham taluy shehaya chayyav bo:
Kol ashamot shebbattora meakkevin et hakkappara chutz measham nazir. sefek nazir usefek mechussere kefara usefek sota kullam meviin karbenotehen achar yom hakkippurim:
Mi shehu mechuyyav chattat o asham vahare hu yotze mibbet din lehareg im haya zivcho zavuach mashhin oto ad sheyyizzarek haddam veachar kach yehareg. veim adayin lo nishchat hazzevach en mashhin oto ad sheyyakrivu alav:

Haose averot harebe behelem achat chayyav chattat al kol achat veachat afillu asa haarbaim veshalosh ellu shemmaninu behelem achat chayyav arbaim veshalosh chattaot. vechen im asa maase echad shehu chayyav alav mishshum shemot harebe chayyav al kol shem veshem vehu shehayu haissurin kullan bain keachat o issur mosif o issur kolel. ketzad. hashshochet behemat kadashim chutz laazara beshabbat laavoda zara chayyav shalosh chattaot. mishshum shochet kadashim bachutz umishshum mechallel shabbat umishshum oved avoda zara shehare sheloshet haissurin bain keachat. bamme devarim amurim beomer bigmar zevicha hu oved otah. aval im lo hayta kavvanato lechach mishsheyyishchot bah meat leshem avoda zara teaser veeno chayyav mishshum shechute chutz ad sheyyishchot shenayim o rov shenayim. venimtza kesheggamar hashshechita shachat behema haasura lekarban sheeno chayyav aleha mishshum shochet bachutz kemo shebbearnu. hayta chattat haof vehaya chatzi kane shellah pagum vehosif bo kol shehu beshabbat leshem avoda zara chayyav shalosh chattaot shehare sheloshet haissurin baim keachat. vechen haose melacha beyom hakkippurim shechal lihyot beshabbat chayyav shete chattaot mippene sheshshene haissurin bain keachat. habba al eshet achiv hakkayyam keshehi nidda mevi shalosh chattaot mishshum eshet ish umishshum eshet ach vehen shene issurin habbain keachat umishshum nidda shehu issur mosif shemmittoch shennitvassef bah issur ze levalah nosaf livamah. vechen kayyotze baze. habba al aviv chayyav shetayim achat mishshum <small>(Vayikra 18 7)</small> "ervat avicha lo tegalle" umishshum <small>(Vayikra 18 22)</small> "veet zachar lo tishkav". vechen habba al achi aviv chayyav shetayim shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 18 14)</small> "ervat achi avicha lo tegalle". habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav behelem achat af al pi shehen shene gufin eno chayyav ella chattat achat shenneemar veet zachar lo tishkav hashshochev vehannishkav shem echad hu. vechen habba al habbehema vehevi behema alav behelem achat eno chayyav ella chattat achat. asu hashshochev vehannishkav bivhema vezachur kivila achat: 
Yesh boel beila achat vechayyav aleha shemone chattaot. ketzad. yaakov shehayta lo bat mizzilpa ushemah timna. nasa lavan timna veholid mimmenna bat ushemah serach. veen lelavan bat ella rachel levaddah. nimtzet serach bat bat yaakov vaachot ishto meaviha hen shene issurin habbain keachat. nisset serach liruven veneesra al shear bene yaakov nosaf bah issur leyaakov vahare hi kallato. met reuven o geresh venisset serach zo laachi yaakov meimmo mittoch shenneesra al shear ache yaakov nosaf leyaakov bah issur eshet achiv. met o geresh venisset serach zo leyishmael mittoch shenneesra al shear ache yishmael nosaf leyaakov bah issur eshet achi aviv. met yishmael venafla leyibbum lifne yitzchak veavar yitzchak veyibbemah af al pi shehi sheniyya lo mittoch shenneesra al shear echav nosaf bah issur leyaakov mishshum eshet aviv umishshum eshet ish sheshshene haissurin bain keachat. im shagag yaakov uva al serach zo keshehi nidda bechayye yitzchak balah uvechayye rachel eshet yaakov hare ze chayyav aleha shemone chattaot. mishshum bat bitto. umishshum achot ishto. umishshum kallato. umishshum eshet achiv. umishshum eshet achi aviv. umishshum eshet aviv. umishshum eshet ish. umishshum nidda. vechen kol kayyotze baze:
Kol ellu shetteaser zo haerva alehen beissur mosif. tzarich sheyyehu haanashim haacherim metzuyin baolam kede shetteaser alehen umittoch shetteaser alehen yitvassef issur acher laze. aval im enan metzuyin en omrin hoil illu haya laze banim o achim hayta neesra alehen yitvassef bah issur lazzaken. shehare en sham atta lo ben velo ach. vechen kol kayyotze bahen:
Mi shehaya nasuy shalosh nashim. uva al immah shel achat mehen shehi em immah shel sheniyya shehi em aviha shel shelishit. af al pi shezzekena zo hi chamoto veem chamoto veem chamiv ushelosha shemot hen veissur bat achat hi eno chayyav ella chattat achat lefi shenneemar beishsha uvittah uvat benah uvat bittah <small>(Vayikra 18 17)</small> "shaara henna zimma hi". hakkatuv asa shelosha gufin keguf echad lefichach yechashvu hashshelosha shemot keshem echad:
Aval habba al achoto shehi achot aviv vehi achot immo chayyav shalosh chattaot shenneemar <small>(Vayikra 20 17)</small> "ervat achoto gilla". chayyav al achoto bifne atzmah veaf al pi shehi achot immo vaachot aviv. veheach tihye zot kegon shebba al immo veholid mimmenna shete banot uvaal achat mibbenotav veholid mimmenna ben. kesheyyavo hammamzer hazze al habbat hashshenit. shehi achot immo hammamzeret. shehi achoto meaviv. shehi achot aviv meimmo. chayyav shalosh chattaot. vechen kol kayyotze baze:

Hava al erva biot harebe behelem achat. af al pi shehaya ben beila uveila yamim harebe. hoil velo noda lo bentayim vahare hi guf echad. hare hakkol shegaga achat veeno chayyav ella chattat achat. aval im shagag bah veachar kach noda lo vechazar veshagag bah atzmah uvealah. veachar kach noda lo vechazar veshagag bah atzmah uvealah. chayyav al kol beila uveila. shehayediot mechallekot hashshegagot:
Habba al haerva biot harebe behelem achat. vezo hannivelet hayta lah yedia ben kol bia uvia. shennimtzeu habbiot etzlah behaalamot harebe. hu mevi chattat achat. vehi mevia chattat al kol bia uvia. hu hayu lo yediot bentayim vehi behelem achat. hu mevi chattaot harebe vehi mevia chattat achat:
Habba al arayot harebe behelem achat. af al pi shekkullan mishshem echad hoil vehen gufim muchlakim chayyav al kol achat veachat. ketzad. hare shebbaal chamesh nashav niddot. o shebba al chamesh achyotav o al chamesh benotav behelem achat. chayyav al kol guf veguf. mikkan atta lamed shezze sheamru chachamim habba al hazzachur vehevi zachur alav behelem achat chayyav chattat achat. bamme devarim amurim keshehaya oto hazzachur atzmo. aval im haya zachur acher. ben shebba al shenayim ben shebba al ze vehevi ze alav chayyav al kol guf veguf. vehu haddin beva al habbehema vehevi behema alav:
Haishsha shehevia aleha behemot harebe behelem achat chayyevet chattat al kol behema uvehema. shehare gufin muchlakin vahare zo kemi shennivala laanashim harebe behelem echad shehi chayyevet chattat al kol ish veish:
Haishsha shehalach balah limdinat hayyam veshama shemmet o shebbau edim shemmet venisset ben al pi atzmah ben al pi bet din. venoda shebbalah kayyam. chayyevet karban echad. veim nisset laanashim harebe o shezzinneta im anashim harebe. chayyevet chattat al kol ish veish mippene shehen gufim muchlakin veaf al pi shehakkol bishgaga achat. habba al hannidda bishgaga vetahara minniddatah vetavla vechazra veraata nidda uva aleha paam sheniyya beotah shegaga atzmah. chayyav al kol paam ufaam. af al pi shehu behelem achat vehu guf echad. shezzeman niddut ze chutz mizzeman niddut hashshenit. vahare hen kishte nashim niddot:
Habba al ishto shello bishat vestah veraata dam bishat hattashmish. hare ellu peturin mikkarban chattat mippene shezze keanus hu velo shogeg. shehashshogeg haya lo livdok uledakdek veillu badak yafe yafe vedikdek bishelot lo haya ba lide shegaga ulefi shello tarach bidrisha uvachakira veachar kach yaase tzarich kappara. aval ze ma lo laasot hare tehora hayta veshello bishat vestah baal en ze ella ones. ulefichach ben shennimtza dam al ed shellah ben shennimtza al ed shello peturin. aval im avar uva aleha samuch lavveset vedimma sheyyivol veyifrosh kodem shettire dam veraata bishat hattashmish. chayyavin bekarban. shezzo hi shegaga. lefichach im nimtza dam al ed shello shenehem temeim vechayyavin bekarban. nimtza al ed shellah. im kinnecha atzmah miyyad keshepperash habbaal velo shahata shenehem temeim vechayyavin bekarban. vim shahata kede shettoshit yadah letachat hakkar o letachat hakkeset vetittol ed livdok bo veachar kach kinnecha atzmah shenehen temeim besafek ufeturin mikkarban. veim shahata kede shettered min hammitta vetadiach et paneha veachar kach kinnecha atzmah venimtza dam. balah tahor:
